verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official CLI for server-side tasks from the terminal (appwrite-docs-52, appwrite-probe-4). It covers managing projects and resources and deploying Functions (appwrite-docs-12), and runs in a non-interactive, headless mode suited to CI and agent automation (appwrite-docs-42). It can also generate a type-safe SDK and type definitions from the database schema (appwrite-docs-41, appwrite-docs-55), and self-hosted instances are supported via the --endpoint flag (appwrite-docs-22). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in AI-agent workflows.
